# Descriptions

## Shared labels

Two records share a label.

### Exercise 1

**Instructions:** Complete both descriptions from the bank.

> Record [8] __________ [A] and record __________ [B] share a label.

**Answer bank:**

- <mark class="correct-answer">[B]</mark> the reference label used for both records in this comparison
- unused label *(not used)*
- <mark class="correct-answer">[A]</mark> the reference label used for both records in this comparison
